scope: local synthetic failure injection and review of prior isolated PostgreSQL acceptance

new_test.name: test_sqlite_disconnect_is_terminal_idempotent_and_new_run_recovers
assertions: failure is persisted and classified at query stage
failure response contains no answer or rows
same-key replay and changed-question conflict do not replan or execute another query
new idempotency key succeeds after the one-shot fault and executes once

command_scope: SQLite disconnect, correlation, and idempotent recovery
cross-principal run visibility and cancellation guard
targeted_regression.environment_note: initial restricted Windows run stalled during asyncio socketpair initialization; authorized local rerun completed assertions

reviewed_existing_controls.partial_database_failure_and_terminal_re: covered by SQLite failure injection; no business query retry
